fusions.name: Snap at the Scent
fusions.desc: A snap carried on the breeze that deals 4 damage to the first enemy it meets, with a 30% chance to leave it [Marked] for 5 seconds.

fusions.name: Howl Sent Ahead
fusions.desc: A howl carried 5 tiles ahead of you in a cone that deals 26 damage to everything in it. If it hits, every ally deals 20% more damage for 12 seconds.

fusions.name: Coursing Hound
fusions.desc: Calls a hound to your side for 15 seconds; it bites enemies within 2 tiles for 4 damage every 1.2 seconds. You move 15% faster for 5 seconds.

fusions.name: The Long Chase
fusions.desc: Every 6 tiles you cover raises your physical damage by 20% for 4 seconds. Once every 6 seconds.
